verdict.rationale: Docs describe explicit background-automation features: scheduled runs for recurring tasks (morning PR reviews, overnight CI analysis, weekly audits), cloud/web sessions for long-running tasks you check back on, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI integration for automated review/triage, and MCP servers that push events (Telegram/Discord/webhooks) into a session while the user is away. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that scheduled or background jobs run reliably unattended over time (only first-party docs cited).
